A '''leather hood''' is the [[Leather armor|leather]] [[Armor#Helmet|helmet]], crafted from 5 [[tattered leather]]. Matcha Flavoured renames the vanilla leather helmet; leather armor is the cheapest armor and softens falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 1 armor and has 200 durability, against 55 for the vanilla item. It also adds 1 block of safe fall distance, so the full set takes 4 blocks off every fall.

=== Dyeing ===
Like vanilla leather armor, it can be dyed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[sturdy leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
